business_problem: Lander & Rogers, an influential Australian law firm with a practice spanning a broad spectrum of sectors and industries, needed to upgrade its fleet of devices to meet the demands of both remote and in-office work.
solution_summary: Lander & Rogers refreshed its end-user computing stack with Surface Laptop 5 and Microsoft's endpoint tooling to support hybrid work at scale. The firm needed devices that could fit into its existing Windows and Azure environment, be provisioned quickly, and be managed through a single-platform ecosystem for both remote and office use. By standardizing on Surface and using modern deployment and management services such as Intune and Autopilot, the IT team sped up rollouts, simplified servicing, and reduced return merchandise authorization tickets. The integrated Microsoft stack gave lawyers and staff a consistent experience while lowering the operational effort needed to deploy, manage, and support devices.

solution_components.name: Surface Laptop
solution_components.role: Standardizes end-user devices to support fast, secure hybrid-work deployments.

solution_components.name: Azure
solution_components.role: Provides the underlying cloud infrastructure, identity, and managed services for the solution.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Teams
solution_components.role: Acts as the collaboration surface for prompts, meetings, and shared knowledge.
